name: flash-exam
description: Solo script di sviluppo: client/ e server/ restano pacchetti installati e deployati separatamente.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
